lead_raw_text:
The structure of TbMg2Ni3 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 24-atom unit cell (Tb4Mg8Ni12) and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all four elements in eight-coordinate, body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements: Mg and Tb each have eight Ni neighbors, while Ni has four Mg and four Tb neighbors, at distances of 2.75–2.77 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Ni and Mg–Tb 8-vertex coordination polyhedra.
